common.tagline: Plan better. Train with criteria. Compete with an edge.

hero.title: Intelligent Sports Planning
hero.subtitle: The platform that transforms training planning into a scientific, measurable and adaptable system for coaches, clubs and academies.

features.title: Everything you need to plan with criteria
features.subtitle: 9 integrated modules covering the complete sports training cycle
features.m1_desc: Role-based registration with granular permissions. Coach, athlete, coordinator and admin.
features.m2_desc: Athlete management with history, discipline, level, goals and detailed observations.
features.m3_desc: Macrocycles, mesocycles and microcycles with 5 models: Traditional, ATR, Block, Undulating and Concurrent.
features.m4_desc: Track duration, volume, intensity, RPE load and rest. Planned vs. actual comparison.
features.m5_desc: Exercise library by sport, physical capacity and method. Custom exercises.
features.m6_desc: Competition tracking by level and A/B/C priority. iCal compatible export.
features.m7_desc: ACWR charts, accumulated load, adherence and professional PDF/Excel export.
features.m8_desc: Intelligent recommender for load adjustments and overload alerts. Decision support.
features.m9_desc: Control panel, user management, event auditing and system usage metrics.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From annual planning to daily sessions in 4 steps
howItWorks.step1_desc: Set up macrocycle, select methodology model and define competitive period goals.
howItWorks.step2_desc: Divide into mesocycles and microcycles with phases, loads and specific capacities.
howItWorks.step3_desc: Capture volume, intensity, RPE load and exercises. Compare planned vs. actual.
howItWorks.step4_desc: Visualize ACWR, accumulated load and adherence. Export professional reports.

pricing.title: Plans & Pricing
pricing.subtitle: From independent coaches to sports organizations
pricing.club_desc: For sports clubs and training academies

models.title: 5 Methodological Models
models.subtitle: The system doesn't impose a model — you choose the right one
models.traditional_desc: Linear progression from volume to intensity. For developing athletes.
models.atr_desc: Sequential blocks: Accumulation, Transformation and Realization.
models.blocks_desc: Concentrated loads with high specificity. For elite athletes.
models.undulating_desc: Non-linear variation of load and intensity within the week.
models.concurrent_desc: Simultaneous development of multiple physical capacities.
